lenses.surface: The `--json` path of `ringer evidence status`: ringer_core/evidence_cli.py, the `evidence status` sub-parser in ringer.py, docs/EVIDENCE.md. Dimensions: the JSON shape and key order against spec.md R2; counting and latest-fallback semantics against the human output (R3); every error kind and exit code (R4); empty files (R5); the guarantee that text mode is unchanged and that stdout holds only the document (R1, R6); timestamp normalization with mixed offsets and naive times; invalid rows (missing or non-string logged_at); duplicate --file arguments; non-UTF-8 and unreadable files; anything that can raise instead of producing an error entry.

tests/test_evidence_status_json.py and the docs/EVIDENCE.md section, read against the code. Dimensions: for each requirement R1-R7 name one concrete mutation of the implementation (flip a comparison, swap two keys, drop an error entry, print extra text to stdout, change an exit code) and say whether any test would fail; tests that cannot fail or mirror the implementation; broad methods hiding which behavior failed; missing edge cases; whether the documentation matches the real behavior and output shape. You may run `python3 -m unittest tests.test_evidence_status_json` from the repo root.
